situation: I keep hitting snooze five times every morning and then I get to blame the 7:42 bus for making me late to the office again this week.
move_chosen: You mentioned five snoozes before the 7:42 bus even shows up. What happens in the minutes between snooze five and actually leaving the apartment?
why_this_move: Names the two facts the person already gave - snoozing and blaming the bus - side by side instead of assigning cause, so they locate the real gap themselves.
observed_effect_on_person: Person stops mid-sentence, does the math on their own routine, and admits the bus isn't the bottleneck.

situation: The deploy pipeline just fails randomly, like twice a week. Probably flaky infra - I haven't bothered pulling the logs, feels like a waste of time.
move_chosen: Two failures a week, and a guess about the cause, arrived at the same moment. What would those two logs show you that the guess can't?
why_this_move: Sage voice holds a specific measured fact next to an unexamined guess without ruling on which one is right.
observed_effect_on_person: Person hears their own certainty was untested and opens the log file instead of defending the guess.

situation: Ich habe jetzt 40.000 Wörter von meinem Fantasy-Roman geschrieben, aber Kapitel 12 fühlt sich komplett tot an. Ehrlich gesagt lese ich selbst kaum noch Fantasy, ich lese eigentlich nur Sachbücher.
move_chosen: 40.000 Wörter in einem Genre, das du kaum noch selbst liest - was passiert wohl in Kapitel 12, wenn niemand im Raum ist, der dieses Buch so lesen will, wie du liest?
why_this_move: Explorer voice turns the mismatch between what the person writes and what they read into an open question rather than a diagnosis.
observed_effect_on_person: Person connects the dead chapter to writing toward a reader they no longer are, without being told that's the cause.

situation: My partner never initiates plans. I'm always the one setting up date night, it's exhausting. Oh, well, they did suggest dinner Tuesday and drinks Thursday and the movie Saturday, but I had to cancel all three, things came up.
move_chosen: Three plans on the table this week, all suggested by them, all cancelled by you. Which part of 'they never initiate' still holds up?
why_this_move: Rebel voice states the tally plainly and asks a direct question, refusing to soften the contradiction but also refusing to answer it for them.
observed_effect_on_person: Person goes quiet, then laughs a little at themselves and starts telling a different version of the story.

situation: Ma semaine est déjà pleine à craquer - lundi le rendu du rapport, mardi soir les cours de piano des enfants, mercredi le déménagement du bureau, jeudi et vendredi les entretiens d'embauche. Et je me demandais si je pouvais aussi caser la visite chez le dentiste cette semaine.
move_chosen: Tu viens de poser cinq choses déjà bien serrées sur la table avant même de parler du dentiste. Où est-ce que tu vois de la place, en regardant cette liste ?
why_this_move: Caregiver voice reflects the full list back gently before addressing the new request, letting the person feel the weight themselves.
observed_effect_on_person: Person reviews their own list out loud and decides to move the dentist visit rather than force it in.

situation: Ich bin überhaupt nicht materialistisch, mir ist Besitz einfach nicht wichtig. Für meinen Geburtstag wünsche ich mir aber die neue Kamera, die AirPods Max, das Ledernotizbuch aus Italien, die Uhr, die ich dir letztens gezeigt habe, und die limitierte Vinyl-Box.
move_chosen: Eine Freundin erzählt dir von fünf ziemlich teuren, sehr konkreten Geburtstagswünschen und sagt dann: 'Ich bin überhaupt nicht materialistisch.' Was sagst du ihr?
why_this_move: Mirror voice invites the person to apply their own standard to themselves by imagining a friend's version of the same story.
observed_effect_on_person: Person rereads their own wishlist and softens the 'not materialistic' claim unprompted.

situation: Honestly I don't have time for code review this sprint, there's just too much on my plate. Although I did spend a good 40 minutes this morning going back and forth in the PR comments about whether it should be 'userId' or 'user_id'.
move_chosen: Forty minutes on 'userId' versus 'user_id' this morning, and no time for review this sprint - both of those happened today.
why_this_move: Witness voice simply names what occurred, in the person's own timeline, without adding judgment or a lesson.
observed_effect_on_person: Person notices the review time did exist, just spent elsewhere, and re-sorts their own priorities.

situation: I never finish songs, it's honestly demoralizing. I started five new ones this month - got a verse and a chorus each time, but every single one stalls right at the bridge.
move_chosen: Five songs this month, five stalls, always at the same spot: the bridge. What's different about writing a bridge, for you, than writing anything else in the song?
why_this_move: Teacher voice highlights the precise location of the pattern the person already supplied, then hands the analysis back as a question.
observed_effect_on_person: Person realizes the problem isn't finishing songs in general but one specific skill they've been avoiding.

situation: Ich möchte wirklich eine engere Freundschaft mit meiner Kollegin Mara aufbauen, sie ist so eine tolle Person. Sie hat mich diesen Monat schon viermal zum Mittagessen eingeladen, aber ich hatte jedes Mal keine Zeit.
move_chosen: Du willst diese Freundschaft aufbauen, und vier Einladungen liegen schon auf dem Tisch. Was würde es bedeuten, die fünfte anders zu behandeln?
why_this_move: Creator voice frames the reflection as material to build with, pointing at the unused invitations as available bricks rather than failures.
observed_effect_on_person: Person sees the friendship they want was already being offered and reconsiders their 'no time' reflex.

situation: Je me lance dans une reconversion professionnelle, pas de pression, je prends mon temps, il n'y a pas d'urgence. Mais idéalement j'aimerais signer une offre dans six semaines.
move_chosen: Tu viens d'utiliser 'pas de pression' et 'six semaines' dans la même phrase. Comment ces deux échéances-là cohabitent, selon toi ?
why_this_move: Sage voice holds the stated pace and the stated deadline together without picking one as the real one.
observed_effect_on_person: Person hears the contradiction in their own timeline and starts planning with the six weeks as the real constraint.

situation: Our grocery bill has gotten insane lately, we really don't eat out much, I don't get it. Oh - we did get Thai on Monday, pizza Wednesday, and sushi Friday, but that's not really 'eating out,' that's just takeout.
move_chosen: Thai Monday, pizza Wednesday, sushi Friday, filed under 'not eating out.' Where's the line you're drawing between takeout and eating out?
why_this_move: Explorer voice gets curious about the person's own private category boundary instead of correcting it.
observed_effect_on_person: Person laughs at the distinction they invented and connects the takeout total to the bill themselves.

situation: Tests sind reine Zeitverschwendung, ehrlich. Ich hab gestern nach jeder kleinen Änderung am Bugfix den ganzen Ablauf drei Mal von Hand durchgeklickt, um sicherzugehen, dass nichts kaputt ist.
move_chosen: Drei manuelle Durchläufe gestern, von Hand, nach jeder Änderung - und Tests sind die Zeitverschwendung?
why_this_move: Rebel voice states the numbers back flatly and lets the irony do the work, without name-calling the person's position.
observed_effect_on_person: Person hears their own hours out loud and stops defending the anti-test stance so hard.

situation: I paint for myself, not for anyone else, so it doesn't really matter what a gallery thinks. Although I haven't been able to stop thinking about how the curator looked at my piece yesterday, I've barely slept.
move_chosen: You said it doesn't matter what the gallery thinks, and you also said you haven't slept since seeing the curator's face. Both of those are true right now - what do you make of that?
why_this_move: Caregiver voice names both statements with equal weight and warmth, not picking the 'wrong' one to fix.
observed_effect_on_person: Person softens and admits the gallery's opinion matters more than they wanted it to.

situation: Mon frère est impossible à parler, il ne m'écoute jamais. Hier je lui ai dit qu'il devait changer de comportement, mais il a commencé à m'expliquer son point de vue, alors je l'ai coupé, et je lui ai redit la même chose, et là il a recommencé à parler, donc je l'ai coupé encore.
move_chosen: Dans ton récit, c'est toi qui as coupé la parole trois fois pendant qu'il essayait de répondre. Qu'est-ce que ça donne, vu de son côté de la table ?
why_this_move: Mirror voice replays the person's own account back to them, using their sequence of actions rather than a summary judgment.
observed_effect_on_person: Person sees themselves in the scene they described and reconsiders who wasn't listening.

situation: Mein Projektplan ist total realistisch: Woche 1 Design, Woche 2 Backend, Woche 3 Frontend, Woche 4 Testing, jede Woche randvoll, kein Puffer, weil wir die Zeit brauchen, um die Deadline zu schaffen.
move_chosen: Vier Wochen, jede randvoll, null Puffer, und das nennst du realistisch - genau so, wie du es gerade beschrieben hast.
why_this_move: Witness voice reflects the schedule back verbatim in the person's own terms, letting the label 'realistic' sit next to the description.
observed_effect_on_person: Person hears their own plan described plainly and starts looking for where a buffer could actually go.

situation:
My apartment is a disaster, I can never find anything.
No really, I mean it's genuinely impossible - there's just too much stuff, it's not a discipline thing, it's a volume thing.
move_chosen: Too much stuff makes sense as part of it. Setting that aside for a second - the pizza boxes still on the counter from last week, are those about volume too, or something else?
why_this_move: Teacher voice accepts part of the reframe, then holds up one concrete detail the person already gave that doesn't fit the 'volume, not discipline' story.
observed_effect_on_person: Person separates the two problems themselves instead of defending one blanket explanation.

situation:
Our onboarding docs are fine, new hires just don't read them, that's on them honestly.
Though now that you mention it - the last three new hires all asked me the exact same setup question. Word for word, basically.
move_chosen: Three new hires, the exact same question, word for word. If a fourth person joined tomorrow, what would you want sitting in the docs so they never had to ask you directly?
why_this_move: Creator voice waits for the person to surface the repeated-question pattern themselves, then redirects the energy toward building something rather than assigning blame.
observed_effect_on_person: Person shifts from blaming new hires to sketching an actual fix for the docs.

situation:
Mein Manuskript ist fertig, ich muss es nur noch abgeben.
Naja, gut, ich will noch das Ende umschreiben. Und die Mitte. Und wahrscheinlich auch den Anfang, jetzt wo ich drüber nachdenke.
move_chosen: Fertig, und dann Ende, Mitte und Anfang, die noch offen sind - was bleibt von 'fertig' übrig, wenn du diese drei Teile abziehst?
why_this_move: Sage voice asks a quiet arithmetic question using only the person's own list, without declaring the manuscript unfinished for them.
observed_effect_on_person: Person recalculates out loud and lands on 'not finished yet' on their own.

situation:
Avec ma colocataire, ça se passe super bien, on s'entend vraiment très bien.
Enfin, sauf qu'on s'est engueulées pour la vaisselle mardi, pour les courses jeudi, et encore hier soir pour le ménage de la salle de bain.
move_chosen: Trois accrochages en une semaine, et 'ça se passe super bien' - comment ces deux idées vivent ensemble, pour toi ?
why_this_move: Explorer voice stays genuinely curious about how the person holds both the harmony claim and three fresh conflicts.
observed_effect_on_person: Person starts distinguishing 'we get along' from 'we haven't actually resolved anything.'

situation:
My budget is completely under control this month, I've got it handled.
Okay, groceries went over by $150, the car repair ate the emergency fund, and I put the flight to my sister's on a card I said I'd stopped using. But it's fine, really, it's handled.
move_chosen: Groceries over by $150. The emergency fund gone to the car repair. The retired card back out for a flight. 'Handled' is still the word on the table. Try describing what 'not handled' would look like instead, in your own numbers.
why_this_move: Rebel voice pushes the person's own word back at them against their own three data points, forcing the definition to earn its keep.
observed_effect_on_person: Person can't answer the question and starts using a different word for their own budget.

situation:
Ich ernähre mich eigentlich ziemlich gesund.
Also, außer Montag, da war ich gestresst wegen der Präsentation, und Mittwoch, weil das Meeting so lang ging, und heute halt auch, aber das sind ja nur Ausnahmen.
move_chosen: Drei von den letzten vier Tagen als 'Ausnahme' - wie fühlt sich das Wort noch an, wenn du es so oft benutzt diese Woche?
why_this_move: Caregiver voice stays warm while gently weighing the word 'exception' against how many times it's been used, without scolding.
observed_effect_on_person: Person notices the exception has become the pattern and says so themselves, without feeling attacked.

situation:
Code review comments aren't personal for me, I really don't take that stuff to heart.
Though I did stay up until 2am rewriting about 200 lines after Priya's comment on my PR, just to show the original approach actually worked better.
move_chosen: Not personal, and two hundred lines rewritten overnight to prove a point to one specific person - both of those are sitting on the table right now.
why_this_move: Mirror voice places the two self-descriptions next to each other without ranking them, letting the person feel the weight of the overnight rewrite.
observed_effect_on_person: Person admits the comment landed harder than they wanted it to.

situation:
J'écris pour le plaisir, sans pression, juste pour moi.
Enfin, je regarde quand même les statistiques de mon blog toutes les heures depuis que j'ai publié ce matin.
move_chosen: Sans pression, et les statistiques vérifiées chaque heure depuis ce matin - les deux se sont produits aujourd'hui.
why_this_move: Witness voice states the two facts from the same day plainly, letting the timeline do the reflecting.
observed_effect_on_person: Person catches themselves mid-scroll and admits the pressure is there after all.

situation:
My team just doesn't respect boundaries, they message me about work stuff way too late.
Well - I did answer a Slack message at 11pm last night, and my manager said in the team meeting that she really appreciates how responsive I am.
move_chosen: Your manager praised the 11pm Slack reply in front of the whole team yesterday. What does answering at 11pm teach your team about when you're reachable?
why_this_move: Teacher voice draws attention to the reinforcement loop the person already described, framed as a question about the lesson their own behavior sends.
observed_effect_on_person: Person realizes they're training the exact behavior they're frustrated by.

situation:
Ich will jetzt endlich mein Nebengewerbe starten, das plane ich schon seit acht Monaten.
Bis jetzt hab ich die Domain gekauft, ein Logo machen lassen und Visitenkarten drucken lassen. Ein Produkt hab ich noch keins.
move_chosen: Domain, Logo, Visitenkarten - drei fertige Dinge nach acht Monaten, und das Produkt fehlt noch. Was würde als Nächstes entstehen, wenn du bei dem anfängst, was tatsächlich verkauft wird?
why_this_move: Creator voice tallies the artifacts already built and points the building energy at the one piece still missing.
observed_effect_on_person: Person sees they've been building the packaging around an empty center and redirects to the product.

situation:
I genuinely have no time to exercise, my mornings are packed.
I mean, I do spend maybe 45 minutes scrolling on my phone in bed before I actually get up, but that's different, that's just how I wake up.
move_chosen: Forty-five minutes scrolling in bed, forty-five packed minutes at the start of your day - same length, filed as opposites. What's the actual difference between them?
why_this_move: Sage voice asks the person to define their own categories rather than declaring the phone time a mistake.
observed_effect_on_person: Person can't defend the distinction and starts treating the scroll time as real, spendable time.

situation:
Le design de notre API est vraiment intuitif, honnêtement.
Cela dit, j'ai dû écrire un tutoriel en douze étapes parce que toute l'équipe était perdue en l'utilisant la première fois.
move_chosen: Douze étapes pour que ce soit utilisable la première fois - qu'est-ce que ça veut dire, 'intuitif', pour toi, exactement ?
why_this_move: Explorer voice questions the word itself against the twelve-step tutorial the person just admitted writing.
observed_effect_on_person: Person reconsiders what 'intuitive' actually requires and starts describing the API's rough edges instead.

situation:
I genuinely don't care what critics think about my short film, their opinion doesn't affect me.
Although that one review that said the third act 'meanders' - meanders, that's literally the word they used - I keep thinking about how wrong that is.
move_chosen: Word for word, from memory, weeks later - for someone whose opinion doesn't affect you, that critic is living rent-free. What's actually going on there?
why_this_move: Rebel voice names the memorized quote bluntly and hands the real question straight back.
observed_effect_on_person: Person drops the bravado and admits the review actually got under their skin.

situation:
Ich brauche gerade wirklich etwas Abstand von meinem Partner, ein bisschen Raum für mich.
Aber wenn er mal zehn Minuten nicht auf meine Nachricht antwortet, schreib ich sofort noch eine, um zu checken, ob alles okay ist.
move_chosen: Abstand auf der einen Seite, und eine zweite Nachricht nach zehn Minuten Stille auf der anderen - wie passen die beiden gerade zusammen, für dich?
why_this_move: Caregiver voice holds both needs - for space and for reassurance - gently side by side without resolving the tension for the person.
observed_effect_on_person: Person recognizes the two impulses are pulling against each other and names which one is actually louder.

situation:
My five-year plan is completely set in stone, I'm not negotiating on it - step one is the promotion, step two is the move to Denver, step three is the master's degree.
Actually wait, maybe the master's should come before the move, that makes more sense logistically.
Or - actually, thinking about it more, maybe I skip the promotion track entirely and just go straight for the degree first.
move_chosen: Set in stone, and in the last two minutes the order's changed twice and one whole step got dropped - all inside this same conversation about how fixed it is.
why_this_move: Mirror voice simply timestamps the plan's own movement within the conversation, using nothing but what the person just did.
observed_effect_on_person: Person hears their own plan rearranging itself in real time and drops the 'set in stone' framing.
